name: statelite
notes: The Vite + React + TypeScript PWA is scaffolded (stat-elite PR #32). checks.unit runs Vitest (App Core tests and the schema SQL self-check); the Playwright smoke at 390x844 runs only in CI (ciGates `test`), because its webServer binds port 4173 with --strictPort and reuses a running server outside CI, so concurrent ICs would test each other's builds. There is no ESLint yet; checks.lint is tsc (fleet #354).
GLOSSARY.md is the glossary; there is no CONTEXT.md. docs/adr/ holds accepted decisions; docs/schema.sql is the planned Supabase schema.
